flux_evidence: Core facts (architecture, JSON schema, licence, endpoints) are stable at 14 weeks old, but LoRA-tooling and quant-file facts still changed meaningfully this cycle (musubi-tuner support, a new official quant, a published hyperparameter recipe) — that's weekly-grade churn, not daily.

findings.claim: The skill frames LoRA training as ai-toolkit + fal only; kohya/musubi are absent from lora-training.md and the wrong-tool table.
findings.reality: kohya-ss/musubi-tuner now has dedicated Ideogram4 support (docs/ideogram4.md, network_module networks.lora_ideogram4, a CaptionVerifier with --validate_caption_structure, blocks_to_swap up to 33) via PRs #966/#975/#977.
findings.fix_hint: references/lora-training.md trainer table + SKILL.md wrong-tool table — add musubi-tuner alongside ai-toolkit/fal.

findings.claim: lora-training.md §~L34 states no published hyperparameter guidance exists for Ideogram 4 LoRAs; fal's product defaults are the only numbers anyone has named.
findings.reality: A named ai-toolkit recipe now exists: rank/alpha 16/16 (32 for higher fidelity), 2500 steps, LR 1e-4 (adamw8bit), checkpoint every 250 steps, and pick an earlier checkpoint since the style sweet spot precedes the final step.
findings.fix_hint: references/lora-training.md ~L34 — replace 'no hyperparameter guidance exists' with this named recipe, still flagged as one author's numbers pending corroboration.

findings.claim: setup-and-workflows.md 'VRAM & quant naming' calls the nf4-vs-nvfp4_mixed ComfyUI filename conflict 'unresolved'.
findings.reality: The Comfy-Org/Ideogram-4 HF repo (the org that ships ComfyUI's official templates) contains no nf4 file at all — only ideogram4_fp8_scaled, ideogram4_nvfp4_mixed, and ideogram4_int8_convrot (each with an unconditional pair). nvfp4_mixed is the confirmed ComfyUI-native 4-bit file.
findings.fix_hint: SKILL.md ~L314 and setup-and-workflows.md §VRAM & quant naming — drop the [flagged] tag, state nvfp4_mixed as fact, note nf4 only exists in the separate diffusers-oriented ideogram-ai/ideogram-4-nf4 repo, not Comfy-Org's.

findings.claim: The skill's quant coverage lists only nf4 and fp8 (SKILL.md ~L172, setup-and-workflows.md §1.2).
findings.reality: Comfy-Org/Ideogram-4 now also ships ideogram4_int8_convrot.safetensors (9.58GB) + its unconditional pair — a third, undocumented quant class, parallel to the int8_convrot builds already covered in this suite's z-image skill.
findings.fix_hint: SKILL.md quant table + setup-and-workflows.md §1.2/§4 — add int8_convrot as a third option; check for any published speed/VRAM comparison against fp8_scaled.

new_techniques.what: ostris published an 'Ideogram 4 TurboTime' LoRA that lets the model run in as little as 2 steps with no CFG and no unconditional model, collapsing the dual-model (conditional+unconditional) architecture into a single fast pass.
new_techniques.why_it_matters: A speed-distillation LoRA analogous to Wan's lightx2v pattern; changes the VRAM/latency calculus and the DualModelGuider requirement the skill documents as mandatory.
